I am a solid rusher, I know when to take risks, and when to wait for a safe moment. I am a team player, if someone is breaking the monument I don't try to get the monument myself, I give them support. I know how to make proper defenses. When I play midfield, I aim to destroy enemy infrastructure, improve my teams infrastructure, and push the enemy back (such as on Halcyon pushing the enemy off their outer island and building an impenetrable fort to hold them off). I am a very strong sniper and I am good with a sword.
I behave appropriately and I will not let your team down!
